hooks._extensionsNote: The markup and style extensions only. Plain .ts/.js are scanned by impeccable's own hook when the project carries a PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md or .impeccable/ folder, but that rule would run the engine on every TypeScript edit in a frontend project; the on-demand pass (impeccable detect --changed) covers those.
hooks._surfaceNote: Findings are folded into the tool result of the edit on opencode (v1 and v2 adapters), so the agent reads them in the same turn; claudecode's python dispatcher cannot mutate a tool result and falls back to the log, which every run keeps.
